remarks: This apartment has just been extensively refreshed and is light bright and move in. Amazing opportunity to live in the heart of New Canaan! This two-bedroom apartment offers a wonderful combination of comfort, character, and convenience. The inviting living room features a handsome wood-burning fireplace, while the well-appointed kitchen includes a built-in washer and dryer. Two bright bedrooms and a full bath complete the home. New energy-efficient propane heating adds to the comfort and efficiency. Large walk in closet. Enjoy the charming grounds, including a delightful private yard and garden setting-an appealing outdoor retreat rarely found so close to town. Ideally located within easy walking distance to New Canaan's vibrant downtown, with its exceptional restaurants, boutique shopping, parks, library, cultural attractions, and Metro-North train station with direct service to Grand Central Terminal. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy all that New Canaan has to offer in a highly desirable in-town location.
